validation.measured_by: src/nba/fit_elo.py against the sportsdataverse archive of 2026-11-04; reproducible with `python -m src.nba.ingest && python -m src.nba.fit_elo`
validation.note: Fitted on 2002-2021 and scored once on 2022-2026, which the search never saw; the 2026-27 season is in progress and is neither fitted nor scored. Seasons are named for the year they end, so 2002 is 2001-02. The held-out scores are what that fit reported, to five decimal places. measured_on_elo_sha256 is sha256 of the canonical "elo" block above, so changing a parameter without re-fitting fails the build instead of publishing this claim over it. No chosen parameter sits on the edge of its grid: k 20 of (8..64), home_advantage 80 of (0..160), offseason_retention 0.6 of (0.3..1.0). The grid for home advantage was deliberately run to 160, past college basketball's fitted 100, so that a higher answer could have been found if there was one. KNOWN PROPERTY: this model is over-confident about favourites. On the holdout it predicted 0.846 where the observed rate was 0.782, and 0.748 where it was 0.678. Its calibration error of 0.0417 is in the same range as the NFL model's 0.0419 and worse than college basketball's 0.0291. The selection criterion was Brier, stated before the search was run, and it is not re-chosen after the fact.
